notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Lys Alana Dignitary.
Repeat.
